$comment: Shared contract test for compute_content_hash (src-tauri/src/lib.rs) and computeContentHash (android-native/.../sync/ContentHash.kt): SHA-256 of the little-endian u64 file size, followed by the first 64KiB, followed by the last 64KiB (only for files > 64KiB). File content for size N is byte[i] = i % 251, generated deterministically so both sides can build the same file from `size` alone.
